$comment: Built-in Nim apps that were deleted from the runtime in favour of a repo JavaScript app (repo/apps/code/<app>). Each control plane rewrites a retired keyword into its replacement when a scene is stored or read (`retire`), and back into the retired keyword when it delivers scenes to a runtime older than `runtime` (`restore`), because such a runtime still has the Nim app and lacks what the replacement needs (`needs`). docs/retired-apps.md is the prose; docs/retired-apps-fixtures.json pins every implementation: backend/app/utils/retired_apps.py, cloud/apps/auth-web/src/lib/retired-apps.ts, and the Pi runtime's fallback (frameos/src/frameos/retired_apps.nim, generated by frameos/tools/generate_retired_apps.py).

data/googlePhotos.needs: frameos.remember (the album list outlives an ESP32 render)

data/openaiImage.needs: app.frame.embedded and saving a data: URL (the b64_json reply)

data/beRecycle.needs: a throw in get() failing the node
